snapshot.name: Clean Science & Technology Ltd
snapshot.about: Incorporated in 2003, Clean Science and Technology Ltd is one of the leading chemical manufacturers globally. It manufactures functionally critical specialty chemicals such as Performance Chemicals (MEHQ, BHA, and AP), Pharmaceutical Intermediates (Guaiacol and DCC), and FMCG Chemicals (4-MAP and Anisole). [1]

business_mix.what_it_does: Clean Science and Technology Limited manufactures specialized chemical products including performance chemicals, pharmaceutical intermediates, FMCG chemicals, and HALS (Hindered Amine Light Stabilizers) products.

promises.credibility: Management frequently makes optimistic assertions about sequential margin and revenue improvements that are occasionally contradicted by reported dips in quarterly margins and sales.

bull: Revenue grew by +22% YoY in the latest quarter Sep 2026, driven by strong quarterly sales performance.
Targeted revenue growth of 30-35% was successfully delivered, with Sep 2026 sales reported at 299.0 INR crore.
The company maintains a strong balance sheet with a Debt/Equity ratio of 0.00 and investments of ₹397 Cr exceeding borrowings.
bear: Growth has slowed significantly, showing a revenue CAGR of only 1% over 3 years compared to 13% over 5y.
Margins are compressing, with the latest operating margin at 30.8% down -4.7pp YoY and historical OPM at 37% versus 44%.
Working capital is stretching as the cash conversion cycle increased from 99 to 118 days.
bull_bear.what_would_change_my_mind: Guidance fulfillment on margin improvements and capacity utilization reaching 55% to 60%.
